ValidationRule.description: Evaluator Cannot Change the evaluator result until Pre-screener Approves
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, 'Accept')), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application"), AND(ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Evaluator cannot change the Evaluator result until Credit Pre screener Result is Accepted.
